## Combined Honours in Biochemistry and Forensic Science

This is a **four-year, full-time joint UBC/BCIT Bachelor of Science program**, delivered in person at **Burnaby Campus and UBC Vancouver**. It combines laboratory-based biochemistry and molecular biology with forensic investigation, forensic biology, chemistry, and evidence analysis.

Examples of required coursework include:

- **UBC BIOL 112 — UBC-BIOL-112 — Biology of the Cell**
- **UBC BIOC 203 — UBC-BIOC-203 — Fundamentals of Biochemistry**
- **UBC CHEM 203 — UBC-CHEM-203 — Introduction to UBC-CHEM-213 — Organic Chemistry**
- **BCIT FSCT 7320 — Introduction to Forensic Science**
- **BCIT FSCT 8150 — Forensic Biology: DNA Typing Theory**
- **BCIT FSCT 8156 — Instrumental Analysis for Forensic Chemistry**

In Year 4, students complete an approved advanced biochemistry pathway, which may include **UBC BIOC 449 — UBC-BIOC-449 — Honours Thesis** or **UBC BIOC 420 — UBC-BIOC-420 — Advanced Biochemical Techniques** plus advanced biochemistry electives. The program requires **132 credits** in total.

More information: [Combined Honours in Biochemistry and Forensic Science](https://www.bcit.ca/programs/combined-honours-in-biochemistry-and-forensic-science-bachelor-of-science-full-time-9940bsc/)

## Combined Honours in Biochemistry and Forensic Science

This is a **four-year, full-time joint UBC/BCIT Bachelor of Science program**, delivered in person at **Burnaby Campus and UBC Vancouver**. It combines laboratory-based biochemistry and molecular biology with forensic investigation, forensic biology, chemistry, and evidence analysis.

Examples of required coursework include:

- **UBC BIOL 112 — Biology of the Cell**
- **UBC BIOC 203 — Fundamentals of Biochemistry**
- **UBC CHEM 203 — Introduction to Organic Chemistry**
- **BCIT FSCT 7320 — Introduction to Forensic Science**
- **BCIT FSCT 8150 — Forensic Biology: DNA Typing Theory**
- **BCIT FSCT 8156 — Instrumental Analysis for Forensic Chemistry**

In Year 4, students complete an approved advanced biochemistry pathway, which may include **UBC BIOC 449 — Honours Thesis** or **UBC BIOC 420 — Advanced Biochemical Techniques** plus advanced biochemistry electives. The program requires **132 credits** in total.

More information: [Combined Honours in Biochemistry and Forensic Science](https://www.bcit.ca/programs/combined-honours-in-biochemistry-and-forensic-science-bachelor-of-science-full-time-9940bsc/)
